compiler-feature-tests.cmd: cargo test --locked -p ontomark-compile --all-features && cargo test --locked -p ontomark-compile --no-default-features

compiler-lints.cmd: cargo clippy --locked -p ontomark-compile --all-features --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo clippy --locked -p ontomark-compile --no-default-features --all-targets -- -D warnings

extraDisciplines: Change only Ontomark-owned parser, model, profile, compiler, RDF and supported reasoner contracts. Hand off Loom ingestion/runtime/scaffolding, VisionGraph page governance, VisionClaw deployment, Agentbox scheduling and VisionFlow integration to their owning repositories.

Browser, Obsidian plugin and wasm32 execution changes require their dedicated acceptance harness; hand off those hypotheses rather than treating these native Rust evaluators as browser or WebAssembly execution evidence.
Use committed synthetic and standards fixtures only. Do not archive, quote, copy or add private estate page bodies, credentials or generated private bundles to reports or patches.

Preserve explicit legacy CLI compatibility. Typed-model migration deviations require a failing witness, documented semantics and consumer migration evidence; no phantom identities, silently fabricated defaults or unsupported-profile success claims.
Preserve dependency licence notices. Do not publish crates, release tags, repin consumers or deploy as part of a nightly patch. Accepted patches require human review and merge.
